archetypes.label: Aggressive Return Specialist (1st-serve neutralizer)
archetypes.blurb: More variable serve than the steady version, often takes bigger swings. Elite at neutralising big first serves. Forces returners into rallies.

archetypes.label: Aggressive Power Server
archetypes.blurb: More variable serve than the steady version, often takes bigger swings. Big serve, weaker on return. Lives or dies by the first delivery.

archetypes.label: Steady Return Specialist (1st-serve neutralizer)
archetypes.blurb: Higher serve consistency than the adaptive version. Elite at neutralising big first serves. Forces returners into rallies.

archetypes.label: Pure Return Specialist (1st-serve neutralizer)
archetypes.blurb: Clearest expression of this archetype in the dataset. Elite at neutralising big first serves. Forces returners into rallies.

archetypes.label: Big-Serve Power Server
archetypes.blurb: Most serve-dominant of this archetype. Big serve, weaker on return. Lives or dies by the first delivery.
